name: RACI Alignment Mapping
deliverable: Structural assignment of Responsible, Accountable, Consulted, and Informed

steps.text: List the decisions or deliverables that need a clear owner before work starts, keeping one per row.
For each row, mark who is responsible for the work and exactly one person accountable for the outcome.
Add who must be consulted before the decision and who only needs to be informed after it.
Check the map for overload and gaps, then confirm each named person accepts the role they were given.

failure: Two accountable names in a row, or a name in every column, so the map looks complete while decisions still stall.
intervention: Put a single accountable name in every row, and remove anyone marked responsible and accountable unless they truly do the work.
provenance: Steps written for this deck from the method's public definition; the source has no protocol.

origin.note: A responsibility charting convention used across project management; no single documented originator.
